_readme: Citations that --strict-citations may pass WITHOUT having verified them at the
topic's declared revision. Each entry waives the revision requirement for one
citation and nothing else: the line checks (past EOF, blank, punctuation-only)
still run, and an allowlisted citation is counted and printed separately as
'allowlisted (unverifiable)' rather than folded into the verified total.
An entry is matched on topic id, diagram id, cited path and line, so it covers
exactly the citation it names. An entry that stops matching anything is stale
and fails the strict gate, which is what stops this file rotting into a blanket
waiver. Adding one is a deliberate, reviewable act: the reason must say why the
citation can never be verified, not why verifying it is inconvenient.
Schema: allow[] of { topic, diagram?, path, line?, reason }.
topic    topic frontmatter id, e.g. VF-02
diagram  diagram id, e.g. VF-02.5; omit to cover every diagram in the topic
path     the cited path, as written in the diagram
line     the cited line; omit to cover every line of that path
reason   why this citation can never resolve at a declared revision
